reuse.why: Uses the existing getMonthActionCategories/shouldSetMonthBudget pair, batchMessages, setBudget and the sheet's sum-amount cell, though the income/expense sign flip is written inline again rather than shared.

duplication.why: Only the small expense sign inversion (already inline in set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg) and the standard month-action loop skeleton are repeated; the category selection rule is not copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler type and registration, and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with the sibling actions; a third inline copy of the sign convention is the only thing a maintainer would have to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending in server/budget/actions.ts goes through getMonthActionCategories and shouldSetMonthBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repeated logic is the inline expense sign flip (`cat.is_income === 1 ? spending : spending * -1`), which is an undisguised restatement of the avg *= -1 pattern in set3MonthAvg/setNMonthAvg.
